script_text: Think Taurus and Cancer are easy? Fixed signs can freeze love. Taurus is Earth, Venus-ruled; Cancer is Water, Moon-ruled, so they nourish but compromise poorly. Symbolically, Taurus occupies the 1st; Cancer rules the 7th, making commitment central. Taurus’s Venus wants touch and proof; Cancer’s traditional Mars wants responsiveness and protective action. A Venus conjunct Cancer Moon promises devotion; a Venus square Mars brings jealousy and control. Taurus Mercury is blunt; Cancer Mercury reads tone, making facts sound like rejection. A Mercury square sparks sulking over 2nd House cash decisions. Saturn rules Taurus; longevity needs a settled Cancer Moon. Retrograde Uranus near 1° Taurus conjuncts a matching Taurus Venus and sextiles early Cancer Moon and Mars, stressing love and money; Jupiter near 5° Leo trines a 5° Taurus 10th House Sun, favoring promotion or a raise. Equal say on family, schedules, and cash makes or breaks love. Comment your partner's sign!
